g.text: Directions: Take 1 capsule daily with water.
Caution: Consult your healthcare provider before use
if you are pregnant, nursing, taking medication or
have a medical condition. Keep out of reach of
Store in a cool, dry place. Do not use if the seal
under the cap is broken or missing.
*These statements have not been evaluated by the Food
and Drug Administration. This product is not intended
to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease.
